tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Full-text search in the puhy.cz catalog (Czech distributor of electronic components, tools, measuring instruments, cables and accessories for professionals; items from our own stock and partner warehouses). Product names are in Czech; matching works best with Czech terms, part numbers or EAN. Return

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Product detail by product_id or EAN: description, price, stock, delivery time, minimum order / package rules. With quantity it returns the orderable quantity (rounded to package size) and line total.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check a list of items with quantities: orderable quantity per item, price, stock, delivery time, goods total, shipping options for that total, and a cart_url. The cart_url opens the puhy.cz cart with these items pre-filled in the user's browser, where the user completes checkout and payment. Suited

tools.name: get_shipping_and_payment
tools.description: Shipping carriers and prices (CZ, SK), free-shipping threshold, payment methods, cash-on-delivery fee, B2B invoicing (EU reverse charge), links to terms and contact.
